script:
Hi, I'm Rohit, and this is Retake.

English is not my first language. Every time I record a demo video, I wonder which words people won't catch.

So I built a tool that listens before the judges do. You paste your script, read it once, and Retake shows the words a listener would miss.

Red means the listener heard a different word. You can click it and hear exactly what they heard.

Then you retake only the marked lines, not the whole video. When the marks are gone, you are ready to record.
